data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ص-ف-و (ṣ-f-w), 'to be pure, clear'. Ṣafiyya means 'pure, sincere'. Its root is ص-ف-و (ṣ-f-w). Borne by Ṣafiyya bint Ḥuyayy, wife of the Prophet ﷺ. Safiya is a Arabic name meaning “Pure; sincere; clear”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Safiya total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
